summary: Ferrari N.V. filed a Form 6-K as a foreign private issuer, furnishing its interim report for the three months ended March 31, 2026. The filing is a routine earnings update containing unaudited interim condensed consolidated financial statements, management discussion, and forward-looking statements. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, or other corporate transaction is disclosed. The report is standard quarterly disclosure under SEC Rule 13a-16, not triggering any special-situations category.
